prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: family dental website hero, editorial photographic story illustration, landscape 3:2 image.
Primary request: an original natural editorial photograph of a child around 7–9 years old sitting upright in a warm orange dental chair with mother close beside them, listening curiously while a dentist's hand shows a plain dental mirror at a comfortable distance. The clinician appears only as partial shoulder and hands at one edge. No instruments in the mouth. The child has a small natural relaxed smile, not exaggerated. This is a calm first-visit familiarization moment, not a treatment result.
Scene/backdrop: airy cream-colored dental interior, warm daylight, a faint green plant softly out of focus, restrained contemporary furnishings.
Composition/framing: medium-wide landscape 3:2, child and mother's faces and the dental mirror grouped near center with spare crop space at both sides, so the photograph works in both a tall desktop crop and a wide mobile crop. Child in front, mother near child, comfortable normal proportions and believable natural interaction. Do not crop any hand awkwardly.
Style/medium: realistic editorial lifestyle photography with authentic skin texture, clothing fabric detail, softly imperfect lived-in realism, professional gentle daylight and warm orange plus cream palette.
Constraints: no logos, no text, no watermark, no toy tooth, no mascot, no advertising captions, no dental treatment in progress, no open mouth examination, no implication of a before/after result. Original scene, no reference to a competitor or existing clinic.
